# Featured Exhibition

## [Grace Hartigan: The Gift of Attention](https://sheldonartmuseum.org/grace-hartigan-gift-of-attention/)

August 14, 2026 through January 3, 2027

Exploring the creative exchange between painter Grace Hartigan and the bold New York poets who inspired her, _Grace Hartigan: The Gift of Attention_ shares a fresh perspective on the pioneering American artist.

## Highlights

[Abstract composition with bold shapes and colors, including green, yellow, red, and white areas.](https://sheldonartmuseum.org/grace-hartigan-gift-of-attention/)

### [Grace Hartigan: The Gift of Attention](https://sheldonartmuseum.org/grace-hartigan-gift-of-attention/)

August 14, 2026 through January 3, 2027

Exploring the creative exchange between painter Grace Hartigan and the bold New York poets who inspired her, _Grace Hartigan: The Gift of Attention_ shares a fresh perspective on the pioneering American artist.

[Colorful abstract artwork with geometric shapes on a vibrant, multicolored background.](https://sheldonartmuseum.org/gender-genre-generation/)

### [Gender, Genre, Generation: Women Painting Abstraction](https://sheldonartmuseum.org/gender-genre-generation/)

August 14, 2026 through January 3, 2027

_Gender, Genre, Generation_ examines the lasting potency of abstraction through the recent work of Candida Alvarez, Rochelle Feinstein, Carrie Moyer, and Amy Sillman—four painters offering the most consequential proposition for abstract painting today.

[Gallery scene with figures studying abstract art in grayscale.](https://sheldonartmuseum.org/remembering-modern-art/)

### [Remembering Modern Art: The Collection of the Museum of American Art, Berlin](https://sheldonartmuseum.org/remembering-modern-art/)

August 14, 2026 through January 3, 2027

Presented in the US for the first time, the collection of the Museum of American Art, Berlin (MoAA) tells the story of the institutions and people that constructed the canon of American modern art at mid-century.

[Grassland with controlled fire lines under a soft, cloudy sky during sunset.](https://sheldonartmuseum.org/new-horizons/)

### [New Horizons](https://sheldonartmuseum.org/new-horizons/)

August 14, 2026 through January 3, 2027

Curated by UNL students in Professor Dana Fritz’s landscape photography seminar, _New Horizons_ presents photographs of the Great Plains that explore the horizon—the region’s defining feature—as a point of connection.

##### Admission to SITE SANTA FE is always free, no advance registration required! Learn more about Tours, Our Building, and Accessibility.

[Come Through!](https://www.sitesantafe.org/en/plan-your-visit)

## Join & Support

SITE SANTA FE is generously supported by forward-thinking art and culture-inspired community members committed to the art and artists making a difference today.

[Get Involved](https://www.sitesantafe.org/en/support)

## Indian Theater

Inspired by both the occupation of Alcatraz by the Indians of All Tribes in 1969 as well as a treatise written at the Institute of American Indian Arts (IAIA) that same year and first published in Santa Fe, New Mexico, this presentation of _Indian Theater: Native Performance, Art, and Self-Determination since 1969_ marks a kind of ‘homecoming’ for the conceptual basis of the groundbreaking exhibition, which has been previously shown in the Northeastern United States and in Canada.

Curated by Candice Hopkins

[Learn more](https://www.sitesantafe.org/en/exhibitions/indian-theater-native-performance-art-and-self-determination-since-1969/)

## Creativity & Learning

SITE SANTA FE connects learners of all ages directly with contemporary art and artists, develops free art coursework for educators, and collaborates with community organizations to develop programming in conversation with exhibitions.

[LEARN MORE](https://www.sitesantafe.org/en/creativity-and-learning)

## Who We Are

SITE SANTA FE’s History, Mission, Vision, Values, and Staff

[Learn More](https://www.sitesantafe.org/en/about)

12th SITE SANTA FE International Biennial

## Once Within a Time

Extending beyond SITE SANTA FE’s galleries to partner institutions and unconventional venues across the city, Once Within a Time draws inspiration from a cast of characters with ties to Santa Fe and New Mexico.

Curated by Cecilia Alemani

[READ MORE](https://www.sitesantafe.org/en/once-within-a-time/)

#### Guided by artists, rooted in New Mexico, SITE SANTA FE celebrates contemporary creative expression.

## The Nation’s Home for American Art & Craft

Located in the heart of downtown Washington, DC, SAAM is home to the most comprehensive collection of American visual culture from the 1600s to today, including the largest collection of [New Deal art](https://americanart.si.edu/exhibitions/experience-america) in the world. The [Renwick Gallery](https://americanart.si.edu/visit/renwick) is a branch of SAAM dedicated to American craft and decorative art.

# Discover the Taft Museum of Art

[Plan Your Visit](https://www.taftmuseum.org/visitor-information/ 'Visitor Information') [Get Tickets](https://www.taftmuseum.org/tickets/ 'Tickets')

On View Now

## Edie McKee Harper: Modernist at Play

[Learn More](https://www.taftmuseum.org/exhibitions/edieharper/ 'EdieHarper') [Get Tickets](https://www.taftmuseum.org/tickets/ 'Tickets')

Closing November 29

## Unfolding Elegance: European Fans from the Taft Collection

[Learn More](https://www.taftmuseum.org/exhibitions/unfoldelegance/ 'UnfoldElegance') [Get Tickets](https://www.taftmuseum.org/tickets/ 'Tickets')

Holidays at the Taft

## Holiday Teas

December 4, 5, 11, 12, 17, 18, 19 | Seatings at 10:30 a.m. and 1 p.m.

[Get Tickets](https://www.taftmuseum.org/holidays/#HolidayTea 'Holidays')

Holidays at the Taft

## Holiday Family Festival

December 6 | 10 a.m.-3:30 p.m.

[Learn More](https://www.taftmuseum.org/holidays/#HolidayFamFest 'Holidays')

## Experience Art

The Taft is home to an impressive art collection displayed in a unique historical setting, changing exhibitions, and world-famous murals. Plus, you can access the museum’s over 800 works of art online, anytime. 

[Learn More](https://www.taftmuseum.org/art/ 'Exhibitions & Collections')

## Explore and Play

Explore the museum through talks, workshops, tours and more designed for all ages!

[Learn More](https://www.taftmuseum.org/tickets/ 'Tickets')

## Indulge Your Palate

Enjoy a scrumptious menu including boozy brunch, savory lunch, and grab-and-go coffee and tea service at the Taft Café.  

[Learn More](https://www.taftmuseum.org/cafe/ 'Café')

## More to Discover

### [Housecats | How Felines Influenced Edie McKee Harper’s Creative Work](https://www.taftmuseum.org/more-to-discover/housecats-how-felines-influenced-edie-mckee-harpers-creative-work/ 'Housecats | How Felines Influenced Edie McKee Harper’s Creative Work')

13 October 2026

Butch. Cookie. Bitsy. Katrinka. These are just a few of the cats who pounced around the household of Edie McKee Harper, Charley Harper, and their son Brett Harper. You can find their essence embedded in the work of these artists, but these whiskered faces specifically take the spotlight across the work of Edie McKee Harper. Explore how cats impacted her artistry and creative process with Senior Manager of Marketing and Engagement Kay E. Bancroft, with research by Assistant Curator Angela Fuller.

### [Modeling Museum Practice | A Commitment to Black Artistry and Robert S. Duncanson's Legacy](https://www.taftmuseum.org/more-to-discover/modeling-museum-practice-a-commitment-to-black-artistry-and-robert-s-duncansons-legacy/ 'Modeling Museum Practice | A Commitment to Black Artistry and Robert S. Duncanson's Legacy')

01 October 2026

Some anniversaries simply invite us to celebrate. Others encourage us to ask why a legacy has endured. As the Taft Museum of Art commemorates the 175th anniversary of Robert S. Duncanson's landmark murals alongside the 40th anniversary of the Duncanson Program, we have a rare opportunity to reflect on how one artist's legacy has evolved from a remarkable chapter in history into a model for museums committed to creativity, community, and cultural equity.

### [A Journey to Conservation | In Conversation with Frederick A. Wallace, 1995 Duncanson Artist-in-Residence](https://www.taftmuseum.org/more-to-discover/a-journey-to-conservation-in-conversation-with-fred-wallace/ 'A Journey to Conservation | In Conversation with Frederick A. Wallace, 1995 Duncanson Artist-in-Residence')

26 August 2026

In 1995, Frederick A. Wallace, conservator, was named the 9th Duncanson Artist-in-Residence at the Taft Museum of Art. But what was his journey to the world of art like, and how did he become a conservator? In this interview, Jae Washington of Cincinnati's Conscience sits down with Wallace to discuss how conservation impacted his career and creative process, and some of his favorite things in Cincinnati.

metadata.title: Studio Museum in Harlem
metadata.description: Studio Museum in Harlem is the nexus for artists of African descent locally, nationally, and internationally and for work that has been inspired and influenced by Black culture. It is a site for the dynamic exchange of ideas about art and society.

The Baker Museum is the foremost fine art museum in Southwest Florida. It is [**accredited**](https://artisnaples.org/baker-museum/accreditation) by the American Alliance of Museums, a recognition of its commitment to excellence and professional standards. Emphasizing modern and contemporary art, the museum hosts several traveling exhibitions annually to complement installations of works from its permanent collections. Dedicated to stewardship and scholarship, The Baker Museum provides world-class exhibitions and educational opportunities for Southwest Florida’s diverse community.

---

[Person in 60s art gallery surrounded by artwork.](https://thealdrich.org/events/getting-contemporary-art-building-a-collection) January 20 at 5:30 pm to January 27, 2027 at 7:00 pm | [Public Programs](https://thealdrich.org/learn/public-programs) [**“Getting” Contemporary Art: Building a Collection**](https://thealdrich.org/events/getting-contemporary-art-building-a-collection) Love contemporary art but don’t know how to start collecting? The newest iteration of The Aldrich’s popular series _“Getting” Contemporary Art_, _“Building a Collection”_ will help to answer questions about acquiring works of art from seasoned experts in the field. Each session will be moderated by Executive Director Cybele Maylone and will feature a reception.  [Left: hand holding plant with a face; middle: woman petting cat with cone; right: bra on a hanger.](https://thealdrich.org/events/vip-and-member-opening-for-kelly-sinnapah-mary-mimi-smith-and-joeun-kim-aatchim) February 6, 2027 at 3:00 pm | Exhibition Opening, Member Preview, Special Event [**VIP and Member Opening for Kelly Sinnapah Mary, Mimi Smith, and Joeun Kim Aatchim**](https://thealdrich.org/events/vip-and-member-opening-for-kelly-sinnapah-mary-mimi-smith-and-joeun-kim-aatchim) Members and friends, please join us to celebrate the opening of [_Kelly Sinnapah Mary: Between earth and sea_](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/kelly-sinnapah-mary) and [_Mimi Smith: Dear Art, A Sixty-Year Survey_](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/mimi-smith) before the exhibitions open to the public and [Aldrich Projects | Joeun Kim Aatchim](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/joeun-kim-aatchim). [Three artworks. Left: woman at a table with a forest background; middle: camouflage dress with bubble belly; right: woman caring for cat wearing a cone.](https://thealdrich.org/events/getting-contemporary-art-2) February 9 at 5:30 pm to February 23, 2027 at 6:30 pm | [Public Programs](https://thealdrich.org/learn/public-programs) [**“Getting” Contemporary Art**](https://thealdrich.org/events/getting-contemporary-art-2) Our popular “Getting” series returns this February! Join art historian and educator Kristen Erickson for three interactive classes exploring The Aldrich’s upcoming exhibitions featuring artists [Kelly Sinnapah Mary](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/kelly-sinnapah-mary), [Mimi Smith](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/mimi-smith), and [Joeun Kim Aatchim](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/joeun-kim-aatchim). [Co-Create in black font against a teal background with a blue squiggly line below.](https://thealdrich.org/events/co-create-a-family-art-adventure-3) February 27, 2027 at 10:30 am | [Children and Family Programs](https://thealdrich.org/learn/children-and-family-programs) [**Co-Create, A Family Art Adventure**](https://thealdrich.org/events/co-create-a-family-art-adventure-3) Looking for a meaningful way to spend a morning with your child or grandchild? Join us at The Aldrich for Co-Create, a family art experience that begins with a shared exploration of the galleries followed by a hands-on art making workshop. ## Upcoming Exhibitions [See all](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/upcoming) [Painting of a figure wearing a floral veil holding a rosary.](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/kelly-sinnapah-mary) February 7, 2027 to June 13, 2027 In the Galleries [**Kelly Sinnapah Mary: Between earth and sea**](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/kelly-sinnapah-mary) [Installation on a wall with a dress-like work at center](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/mimi-smith) February 7, 2027 to September 19, 2027 In the Galleries [**Mimi Smith: Dear Art, A Sixty-Year Survey**](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/mimi-smith) [Framed assemblage of primarily pink and white materials.](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/bonnie-lucas) June 27, 2027 to January 30, 2028 In the Galleries [**Bonnie Lucas: Material Girls, A Survey**](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/bonnie-lucas) [Sculpture of a white house with a blue roof.](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/brandon-morris) October 17, 2027 to May 28, 2028 In the Galleries [**Brandon Morris**](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/brandon-morris) [Three abstract works hung on a wall each with silver metallic sculpture elements organically wrapped around them.](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/anastasia-komar) October 17, 2027 to May 28, 2028 In the Galleries [**Anastasia Komar: Ouijatari**](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/anastasia-komar) [A kneeling woman with long blue hair petting a black cat wearing a medical cone around its neck.](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/joeun-kim-aatchim) Aldrich Projects | January 14, 2027 to May 16, 2027 In the Galleries [**Joeun Kim Aatchim**](https://thealdrich.org/exhibitions/joeun-kim-aatchim) ## # Welcome

We are a museum at the University of Kansas with two floors of galleries and a collection that represents different types of art from around the world. Admission is free for everyone!

## Looking After

### Looking After: Art and Care in Education Across Kansas

Explore the many ways that art can facilitate learning through more than 80 works from our collection and interactive stations.

[Learn more >](https://spencerart.ku.edu/exhibitions-and-events/exhibitions/current-exhibitions/looking-after-art-and-care-education-across-kansas 'Learn more >')

## Happening at the museum

[View our holiday hours >](https://spencerart.ku.edu/visit/plan-your-visit 'View our holiday hours >')

### [Asclepias in the Garden](https://spencerart.ku.edu/exhibitions/current-exhibitions/asclepias-garden 'Learn more >')

This exhibition at the KU Medical Center was developed by artist Marguerite Perret as part of the Kansas 4M/KU Spencer Museum of Art Arts Research Integration Fellowship.

[Learn more >](https://spencerart.ku.edu/exhibitions/current-exhibitions/asclepias-garden 'Learn more >')

[Learn more about the "Christian Thompson: Future Ancestor" exhibition](https://spencerart.ku.edu/exhibitions-and-events/exhibitions/current-exhibitions/christian-thompson-future-ancestor 'Learn more >')

### [Christian Thompson: Future Ancestor](https://spencerart.ku.edu/exhibitions-and-events/exhibitions/current-exhibitions/christian-thompson-future-ancestor 'Learn more >')

Experience two photographs and one video work by Australian artist Christian Thompson that explore language preservation and cultural survival.

[Learn more >](https://spencerart.ku.edu/exhibitions-and-events/exhibitions/current-exhibitions/christian-thompson-future-ancestor 'Learn more >')

## Your Next Visit Awaits

With something to do for everyone at The Frick Pittsburgh Museums & Gardens, fill your holiday season with cheer when you visit for a [_Home for the Holidays at Clayton_](https://www.thefrickpittsburgh.org/Event-Home-for-the-Holidays-at-Clayton) tour. See the historic house of Henry Clay Frick festively decorated and learn about how Pittsburghers in the Gilded Age celebrated all the winter holidays. Whether taking a tour, [sipping on a warm drink at The Café at the Frick](https://www.thefrickpittsburgh.org/cafe), or joining one of our [seasonal programs](https://www.thefrickpittsburgh.org/calendar), we are your one-stop destination for family fun and ringing in the most wonderful time of the year. Make the Frick part of your new year plans as well when you buy or reserve your tickets to [_Soul, Sound & Voice: Watercolors of Jerry Pinkney_](https://www.thefrickpittsburgh.org/Exhibition-Soul-Sound-Voice-Watercolors-by-Jerry-Pinkney), an exhibition of nearly 100 luminous illustrations by a Pennsylvania artist.

#### Scenic Gardens & Greenhouse

The path that winds through the Frick’s 10-acre site is lined with lush gardens and a diverse selection of trees. Our active greenhouse is a renovation and partial reconstruction of one that served the Frick family from 1897 through the 1970s.

## The Most Fashionable Museum in New York City

Best known for its innovation and award-winning exhibitions, the museum has a permanent collection of more than 50,000 garments and accessories dating from the eighteenth century  to the present.

### [Explore our Online Collections](http://fashionmuseum.fitnyc.edu/)

The museum's online collections feature more than 2,500 object images as well as installation images from over 100 past exhibitions.

[Explore Online Collections](https://fashionmuseum.fitnyc.edu/collections)

### [Exhibitions](https://www.fitnyc.edu/museum/exhibitions/index.php?exhibitions=current)

Get inspired by our exhibitions, such as "Doll Dressing"

[Visit Exhibitions Page](https://www.fitnyc.edu/museum/exhibitions/index.php)

### [FIT Giving Day](https://foundation.fitnyc.edu/g/fitnyc-day-of-giving-2026/the-museum-at-fit)

Your support on Nov 19, 2026 will help preserve fashion’s legacy, inspire future innovators, and keep The Museum at FIT accessible to all.

### [We Love Dolls Submissions](https://bit.ly/WeLoveDollsMFIT)

We’ve received so many charming, funny, heartfelt, creative, and inspiring stories. Head over to Tumblr to read some #WeLoveDollsMFIT stories.

Share your favorite doll with us!! Join our crowd-sourced project We Love Dolls! It's related to the forthcoming exhibition "Doll Dressing" opening September 16, 2026. The exhibition explores the history of fashion dolls and the influence of dolls on high fashion. We hope you'll contribute a story about your doll!

## [Pierced Hearts & True Love: A Century of Drawings for Tattoos](https://drawingcenter.org/exhibitions/pierced-hearts-true-love-a-century-of-drawings-for-tattoos)

September 16 – November 11, 1995

From sandpaper drawings to paper-cutting, drawing resists conventional definitions, as seen in the 1995 exhibition _Pierced Hearts and True Love: A Century of Drawings for Tattoos_. Tracing the evolution of early 20th century flash tattoos to contemporary practice, the show explored the tradition of tattooing through finished drawings, sketchbooks, rough studies, historical photographs, original tattoo parlor signs, and tattoo machines.

## [Welcome to the Frick!](https://www.frick.org/interact/welcome_frick)

Steve Martin narrates this immersive introduction to the wonders of The Frick Collection in New York City. Following a major renovation completed in spring 2025, the museum invites you to rediscover its unique atmosphere and collections in its historic home at 1 East 70th Street—a place to slow down and get closer to objects of beauty and awe.

Learn about the museum’s founder, industrialist Henry Clay Frick, as well as the history of its iconic buildings and holdings, including the creation of the Frick Art Research Library by Helen Clay Frick. The video also traces the institution’s evolution over time, from a private Gilded Age mansion to a civic resource “for the use and benefit of all persons whomsoever,” offering educational programs, special exhibitions, concerts, events, and more.

The Frick has inspired generations of museumgoers, artists, writers—and even comedians! [Plan your visit](https://www.frick.org/visit) today and discover it for yourself.

We welcome everyone with inclusive experiences that spark curiosity and foster [community](https://newarkmuseumart.org/visit/our-city/).

Through your [membership](https://newarkmuseumart.org/join-give/membership/) and [donations](https://newarkmuseumart.org/donate/) you are supporting us in offering access to world renowned [collections](https://newarkmuseumart.org/collections/collection-areas/) of American art, decorative arts, contemporary art, and arts of Asia, Africa, the Americas, and the ancient world. ## Explore

### [This Land Is Alive](https://www.huntington.org/watch-read-listen/news/land-alive)

News

Terry Tempest Williams and President Karen R. Lawrence on Attention, Revision, and the Open Space of Democracy.

### [Library Acquisitions Reveal How History Is Recorded](https://www.huntington.org/watch-read-listen/news/library-acquisitions-reveal-how-history-recorded-and-what-it-leaves-out)

News

Six manuscript, book, and photo acquisitions span histories from Edo-period Japan and Arctic exploration to early America, English criminal justice, colonial Mexico, and experimental photography in Los Angeles.

### [“This Land Is ...” Marks America’s 250th](https://www.huntington.org/watch-read-listen/news/huntingtons-land-exhibition-marks-250th-anniversary-declaration-independence-announcement)

News

In dialogue with the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, the exhibition explores how the ideals of life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness are intertwined with place. 

### [The Huntington Expands Art Collection](https://www.huntington.org/watch-read-listen/news/huntington-expands-art-collection-significant-new-acquisitions)

News

Five new acquisitions spanning five centuries deepen the Art Museum’s holdings and expand opportunities for research and interpretation.

### [“Petromania” Traces the Art of Stone Appreciation](https://www.huntington.org/watch-read-listen/news/huntington-explores-art-stone-appreciation-across-asia-and-america)

News

The exhibition reveals more than a millennium of stone appreciation across China, Japan, and the United States.

### [The Huntington Announces Its 2027 Lineup](https://www.huntington.org/watch-read-listen/news/huntington-announces-2027-exhibition-and-installation-schedule)

News

The 2027 programs span art, literature, film, and nature, featuring David Hockney, William Blake, short films by Ghetto Film School students, and rarely seen materials from the Library’s collections.

### [Laura Aguilar’s Photographs of Día de los Muertos Go on View](https://www.huntington.org/watch-read-listen/news/laura-aguilars-photographs-dia-de-los-muertos-day-dead-go-view-huntington)

News

Opening Sept. 20, the exhibition features Laura Aguilar’s photographs of Día de los Muertos celebrations in homes and at public events in Los Angeles.

### [Integratron and UFO Archive Joins The Huntington](https://www.huntington.org/watch-read-listen/news/huntington-acquires-archive-integratron-and-ufo-movement)

News

Collection includes architectural plans, photographs, recordings, and other materials tracing the history of the Mojave Desert landmark and Southern California’s UFO community.

### [New Publication Explores History of Science](https://www.huntington.org/watch-read-listen/news/huntington-and-princeton-university-press-publish-five-volume-work-exploring)

News

Worlds Unfolding: Science on the Page explores centuries of curiosity, discovery, and visual culture, from medieval manuscripts to space exploration.

### [The Golden Apple of Democracy](https://www.huntington.org/watch-read-listen/news/golden-apple-democracy)

News

Harvard scholar Danielle Allen explores the Declaration’s promise of equality in Shapiro Lecture connected to “This Land Is ...”

### [Huntington Presents New “Stories from the Library”](https://www.huntington.org/watch-read-listen/news/huntington-presents-stories-library-damaged-goods-and-mirror-moon)

News

New exhibitions in the “Stories from the Library” series explore how imperfect objects preserve human stories and how the moon has shaped science, art, literature, and imagination.

### At the Heart of it All

#### Sight and Sound: Composer Interviews

When you visit a fine arts museum, you probably expect to see paintings, sculptures, and other visual art, but you may not expect to be greeted by live opera music. This fall, the Utah Museum of Fine Arts invites you to treat your eyes _and ears_ to world-class art! Sight & Sound at the UMFA offers free music performances for the public, inspired by art at the Museum.

[Read the Blog](https://umfa.utah.edu/sight-and-sound-composer-interviews/)

#### Collecting for the Future

How does a museum build a collection? Why do museums choose specific objects to steward for future generations? Explore these questions and more in this special video blog.

[Read the blog](https://umfa.utah.edu/collecting-for-the-future/)

#### Ballerina, Hollywood Star, and Egyptologist: The Life and Legacy of Natacha Rambova

The collection at the Utah Museum of Fine Art spans 5,000 years of human creativity (and counting)! The UMFA’s collection of over 22,000 objects is the result of generations of curators, Museum employees, and the generosity of countless donors. One contributor in particular had a profound impact on the Museum, and her portrait is currently on view in the UMFA portrait hall. Natacha Rambova was a ballerina, a Hollywood designer, an actress, one half of a celebrity power couple, and had a serious career in Egyptology.

[Read the Blog](https://umfa.utah.edu/ballerina-hollywood-star-and-egyptologist-the-life-and-legacy-of-natacha-rambova/)

### Inspiring Critical Dialogue and Illuminating the Role of Art in Our Lives

The UMFA is about more than objects—it’s about helping you connect in meaningful ways to great art and ideas, to the fascinating history of human culture and creativity, at your own pace.

No matter how young you are, what you know, or where you’re from, works of art are one-of-a-kind human creations that tell unique stories, evoke memories, inspire conversations, and open possibilities.

Find yourself here and explore the critical conversations waiting in the galleries.

[Plan your visit](https://umfa.utah.edu/visit/)

## Museum News & Happenings

[Ring in the Season with VBMA’s ‘Holidays at the Museum’](https://vbmuseum.org/ring-in-the-season-with-vbmas-holidays-at-the-museum/)

## [Ring in the Season with VBMA’s ‘Holidays at the Museum’](https://vbmuseum.org/ring-in-the-season-with-vbmas-holidays-at-the-museum/)

Head over to the Vero Beach Museum of Art on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m. to celebrate the season at the Holidays at the Museum community festival. Children, families, and adults of all ages will enjoy free admission to the entire Museum—including the Hokusai, Hiroshige, Hasui: Japanese Landscapes in Print exhibition, which makes its American debut at VBMA—along with holiday-themed and exhibition-inspired art making, music and dance performances, food trucks, and other activities for the whole family to enjoy.

[The ‘New York Ten’—A Portfolio of Work Gifted to VBMA by Mark and Cindy Galant](https://vbmuseum.org/the-new-york-ten-a-portfolio-of-work-gifted-to-vbma-by-mark-and-cindy-galant/)

## [The ‘New York Ten’—A Portfolio of Work Gifted to VBMA by Mark and Cindy Galant](https://vbmuseum.org/the-new-york-ten-a-portfolio-of-work-gifted-to-vbma-by-mark-and-cindy-galant/)

The ‘New York Ten’ is a portfolio of ten prints published in 1965 by Tanglewood Press, a highly regarded fine art publisher active from 1964 to 1991 whose editions include works by many of the 20th century’s most influential artists. The portfolio is held in the permanent collections of both the Metropolitan Museum of Art and the Museum of Modern Art, and now, thanks to the generosity of Mark and Cindy Galant, the Vero Beach Museum of Art holds a complete set of prints.

[Vero Beach Museum of Art to Open Satellite “Hub” in March 2027](https://vbmuseum.org/vero-beach-museum-of-art-to-open-satellite-hub-in-march-2027/)

## [Vero Beach Museum of Art to Open Satellite “Hub” in March 2027](https://vbmuseum.org/vero-beach-museum-of-art-to-open-satellite-hub-in-march-2027/)

At the conclusion of a dynamic and informative 2026–2027 season, rich with lectures, performances, art classes, and first-of-its-kind exhibitions, the Vero Beach Museum of Art, in mid-February 2027, will be saying goodbye to its current facility to forward the development of a new VBMA campus in Riverside Park, opening in 2028. The Museum will vacate the entire facility, except the Collections Wing, to make way for indoor and outdoor community gathering spaces, galleries, gardens, terraces, and courtyards that will comprise a new, comprehensive arts center for the Vero Beach community and beyond.

[Programs for Veterans Create Community of Creativity and Support](https://vbmuseum.org/programs-for-veterans-create-community-of-creativity-and-support/)

## [Programs for Veterans Create Community of Creativity and Support](https://vbmuseum.org/programs-for-veterans-create-community-of-creativity-and-support/)

Exploring creativity is a vital goal of the free Veterans’ Program offered at the Vero Beach Museum of Art. Veterans draw inspiration from instructor-led gallery visits, then head to the studios to try their hand at a variety of artistic techniques. The classes have a critical side benefit: they create community for an important segment of our local residents seeking an outlet.

[Vero Beach Museum of Art Adds Two Global Finance Leaders to its Board of Trustees](https://vbmuseum.org/vero-beach-museum-of-art-adds-two-global-finance-leaders-to-its-board-of-trustees/)

## [Vero Beach Museum of Art Adds Two Global Finance Leaders to its Board of Trustees](https://vbmuseum.org/vero-beach-museum-of-art-adds-two-global-finance-leaders-to-its-board-of-trustees/)

At its annual meeting, the Vero Beach Museum of Art’s Board of Trustees demonstrated its continued commitment to exemplary governance and long-term stewardship by welcoming new Trustee Alan Wilkinson, elected in March, and electing Kevin D. Willsey to the Board. Elected to serve for second three-year Board terms were Trustees Mary E. Blair, Lisa Bullock, Sherry Ann Dayton, Richard Frary, and Chair Richard D. Segal. Vice Chair James C. Penrose was renewed for a third three-year term.

[VBMA Early Childhood Programs Build Critical Foundations for Creative Learning](https://vbmuseum.org/vbma-early-childhood-programs-build-critical-foundations-for-creative-learning/)

## [VBMA Early Childhood Programs Build Critical Foundations for Creative Learning](https://vbmuseum.org/vbma-early-childhood-programs-build-critical-foundations-for-creative-learning/)

For more than 40 years, the Vero Beach Museum of Art has positioned education at the forefront of its mission. Its engaging exhibitions, lectures, events, classes, workshops, and outreach programs are widely attended by Vero Beach and Indian River County residents.

### Rick Lowe: Turning data and social research into art

In his latest exhibition, at the University of Michigan Museum of Art in Ann Arbor, artist Rick Lowe explores a complex, untold story of Black America, by translating socio-economic data about progress made by Black Americans into art.

# Welcome to the Virginia Museum of Fine Arts

Today's hours:

10 am–5 pm

We're open 365 days a year.

General admission is always free. 

Experience a world-class art museum with hometown hospitality. The Virginia Museum of Fine Arts houses a remarkable permanent collection of more than 50,000 works of art from almost every major world culture.

[Plan Your Visit](https://www.vmfa.museum/visit/plan-your-visit) [See What's On](https://www.vmfa.museum/calendar)

We offer classes for art enthusiasts of all experience levels and ages—from infancy to infinity. Registration for winter-spring classes begin on November 17 for VMFA members and on November 24 for nonmembers.

[Plan to visit](https://thewalters.org/visit/)

The Walters belongs to everyone. We are an art museum located in the heart of Baltimore’s historic Mount Vernon neighborhood that is rooted in community and open to all. Admission to the Walters Art Museum is always free.

[**Luxury & Loss: Feather, Shell, Tusk, Horn**\\ \\ Through Jan. 24, 2027\\ \\ Centre Street: First Floor](https://thewalters.org/exhibitions/luxury-loss/)

[**Distinctive Design: European and North American Decorative Arts**\\ \\ Ongoing\\ \\ Hackerman House at One West Mount Vernon Place, Carriage House](https://thewalters.org/exhibitions/distinctive-design/)

[**Across Asia: Arts of Asia and the Islamic World**\\ \\ Ongoing\\ \\ Centre Street Building, Level 4](https://thewalters.org/exhibitions/asia/)

[See all exhibitions](https://thewalters.org/exhibitions/)

- [**Claude Monet, Springtime, 1872.**](http://art.thewalters.org/object/37.11)

[Explore digital collection](https://art.thewalters.org/)

## The Walters is for...

### Families and Kids

Interactive programs and hands-on experiences invite children and their caregivers to explore art together, blending learning, creativity, and play in welcoming spaces for all ages.

Upcoming

[Drop-in Art Making: Creative Harvest](https://thewalters.org/event/creative-harvest-2/)

Sat., Nov. 21, 2026, 10 a.m.

[Learn more](https://thewalters.org/learn/kids/)

### Teachers and Students

Curriculum-aligned experiences support critical thinking and creative exploration across grade levels.

Upcoming

[Sketching Sessions](https://thewalters.org/event/sketching-sessions-2/)

Thurs., Nov. 19, 2026, 6 p.m.

[Learn more](https://thewalters.org/learn/teachers/)

### Teens

Teen-focused programs support self-expression, identity exploration, and social connection through art, encouraging collaboration with peers and mentorship from adults.

Upcoming

[Printmaking for Teens: Making Ink](https://thewalters.org/event/printmaking-for-teens-making-ink/)

Thurs., Dec. 3, 2026, 4 p.m.

[Learn more](https://thewalters.org/learn/teens/)

### College Students

From engaging tours to internship and fellowship opportunities, programs for college students support and empower the next generation of museum professionals.

[Learn more](https://thewalters.org/learn/college/)

### Lifelong Learners

Lectures, tours, and programs for adult learners inspire ongoing discovery, fresh perspectives, and a broader understanding of art and history.

Upcoming

[Sketching Sessions](https://thewalters.org/event/sketching-sessions-2/)

Thurs., Nov. 19, 2026, 6 p.m.

[Learn more](https://thewalters.org/learn/life/)

### Everyone

Exhibitions, programs, and open-access digital resources for all ages spark curiosity and connection with the Walters both in person and around the world.

Upcoming

[Conservation Window](https://thewalters.org/event/conservation-window/2026-11-20/)

# Welcome

Explore art and ideas at MoMA.

The museum is open 10:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. today.

[Plan your visit](https://www.moma.org/visit/)

## Exhibitions

 [Brancusi: The Artist and His Studio\\ \\ Through Feb 27, 2027](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/5910)

 [Taking Back Our Space: Photographic Perspectives\\ \\ Through May 2, 2027](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/5678)

 [The Surrealist Book: Tomorrow Lives in Mirrors\\ \\ Through Jan 23, 2027](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/5918)

 [Full Disclosure: The Edge of Information Design\\ \\ Through Jun 13, 2027](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/5926)

 [Nilima Sheikh: Fractured Skies\\ \\ Through Jun 13, 2027](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/5932)

 [Architects of Liberation: Modernism in Western Africa\\ \\ Through Jan 2, 2027](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/5906)

 [Jakob Kudsk Steensen: Wetland\\ \\ Through Mar 7, 2027](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/5936)

 [Pierre Huyghe: UUmwelt\\ \\ Last chance\\ \\ Through Nov 29](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/5912)

 [Odili Donald Odita: Songs from Life\\ \\ Through Feb 21, 2027](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/5794)

 [It’s Alive! A Century of Animation from the Collection\\ \\ Aug 1, 2026–Summer 2027](https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/5920)

## Support experimentation, 
learning, and creativity

Gifts to the Modern Fund enable MoMA to be a champion for the art of our time, a gathering place for all, and a home for artists and their ideas.

[Donate to the Modern Fund](https://donate.moma.org/)

## Art and artists 
in our collection

Discover artworks that speak to 
you, from the 1880s to today.

[Find your favorites](https://www.moma.org/collection)

- [Henri Matisse\\ \\ _Dance (I)_](https://www.moma.org/collection/works/79124)
- [Meret Oppenheim\\ \\ _Object_](https://www.moma.org/collection/works/80997)
- [Joan Mitchell\\ \\ _Ladybug_](https://www.moma.org/collection/works/79586)
- [Romare Bearden\\ \\ _The Dove_](https://www.moma.org/collection/works/196975)
- [Montien Boonma\\ \\ _House of Hope_](https://www.moma.org/collection/works/444857)
- [Vincent van Gogh\\ \\ _The Starry Night_](https://www.moma.org/collection/works/79802)
- [Tauba Auerbach\\ \\ _Ziggurat_ from _\[2,3\]_](https://www.moma.org/collection/works/157565)
- [Andy Warhol\\ \\ Untitled from _Flowers_](https://www.moma.org/collection/works/64280)
- [Man Ray (Emmanuel Radnitzky)\\ \\ Chess Set](https://www.moma.org/collection/works/2807)

[Find your favorites](https://www.moma.org/collection)

## Events for everyone

Join us for films, performances, 
art making, talks, and more.

[View the calendar](https://www.moma.org/calendar)

- [**Family Story Time**\\ \\ Workshop\\ \\ Enjoy a new story celebrating creativity and imagination, then explore materials, movement, color, or shape through a related activity.](https://www.moma.org/calendar/events/11745)
- [**_Disclosure Day_. 2026. Directed by Steven Spielberg**\\ \\ Steven Spielberg’s first film in four years brings him back to the subject that has fascinated him since childhood: alien life on Earth.](https://www.moma.org/calendar/events/11802)
- [**Member Gallery Talk: _Brancusi: ** The Artist and His Studio_\\ \\ Dive deeper into _Brancusi: The Artist and His Studio_ on this free, member-only tour.](https://www.moma.org/calendar/events/11886)

Enrich your visit with tours, dining, 
shopping, and other experiences.

[Plan your visit](https://www.moma.org/visit)

[Plan your visit](https://www.moma.org/visit)

## Free admission during 
UNIQLO Friday Nights

MoMA is open late every Friday and is free for New York State residents. Join us for an evening of art, creativity, and more.

[Get UNIQLO tickets](https://visit.moma.org/select/uniqlo)

[View all exhibitions](https://whitney.org/exhibitions)

---

### [Free at the Whitney](https://whitney.org/visit/free-admission)

Every Friday evening from 5–10 pm and on the second Sunday of every month, admission to the Museum is free. Both offerings include free access to exhibitions, special programming, city views, and more. Visitors 25 and under are always free, every day. 

[More about free offerings](https://whitney.org/visit/free-admission)

[Model zipping a red-and-blue dotted sherpa fleece inspired by Lichtenstein’s Cathedral #2](https://shop.whitney.org/collections/gap-lichtenstein-whitney)

### Gap–Lichtenstein–Whitney

Our collaboration with Gap and the Estate of Roy Lichtenstein brings the artist’s bold visual language to an 18-piece collection of clothing and accessories. Bold patterns on sherpa. Graphic prints on tees. This is art—worn by you.

[Shop the Collaboration](https://shop.whitney.org/collections/gap-lichtenstein-whitney)

[Child drawing on paper titled "Seven Soothing Sketches" with colorful markers and a pill organizer on a table.](https://whitney.org/families)

### [Family Programs](https://whitney.org/families)

Whitney family programs offer artmaking workshops, special events and tours, in-gallery activity guides, and at-home artmaking challenges. Join us for [upcoming family events](https://whitney.org/familyprograms) or [Free Second Sundays](https://whitney.org/visit/second-sundays).

[More about family programs](https://whitney.org/families)

Listen to [_Artists Among Us_](https://whitney.org/audio/podcasts), featuring long-form and short-form podcasts exploring artworks and events in and around the Whitney through conversation.

@graph.name: Whitney Museum of American Art
@graph.description: Discover what’s new in American art in the heart of Manhattan’s Meatpacking District. The Whitney presents cutting-edge exhibitions by today’s most celebrated artists alongside masterworks by Edward Hopper, Georgia O’Keeffe, Jacob Lawrence, and others. Take in skyline views from the Museum’s terraces, enjoy free daily tours and family artmaking, browse the Whitney Shop, and dine at the ground-floor Frenchette Bakery or the 8th-floor Studio Bar.

## Welcome to the Wichita Art Museum

WAM offers a vibrant space for all ages to deepen their connection with the arts. Explore our diverse collections, exhibitions, programs, and family-friendly activities. 

[Plan Your Visit](https://wam.org/visit/plan-your-visit/)

[Featured Exhibition\\ \\ **David Hornback: Where the Hell is Wichita?**\\ \\ July 25 - December 12, 2026\\ \\ Nostalgic photographs of Wichita life from David Hornback.\\ \\ Peer into the high school years of Photographer David Hornback—the earliest images of the artist’s distinguished career.  About David Hornback: Where the Hell is Wichita?](https://wam.org/whats-on/exhibitions/david-hornback-where-is-wichita/) 

[Featured Exhibition\\ \\ **Emilio Sánchez: Sunlight and Shadow**\\ \\ June 13, 2026 – June 14, 2027\\ \\ American scene painting by Emilio Sánchez: urban, architectural scenes—often inspired by streetscapes in Miami, Havana, the Caribbean, and the Bronx.\\ \\ Join Emilio Sánchez in exploring a world of light and shadow, peering around storefronts, into alleyways, and inside homes.  About Emilio Sánchez: Sunlight and Shadow](https://wam.org/whats-on/exhibitions/emilio-sanchez-sunlight-and-shadow/) 

[Featured Exhibition\\ \\ **Armando Minjárez Monárrez: En Cuerpo Presente**\\ \\ August 28, 2026 - February 7, 2027\\ \\ **_Armando Minjárez Monárrez: En Cuerpo Presente_** | Naftzger Family Regional Creatives Exhibition Series\\ \\ Armando Minjárez Monárrez: En Cuerpo Presente explores how images become instruments of power. Monuments, rituals, architecture, souvenirs, advertisements, and brands across history have shaped not only how we see one another, but how we come to understand ourselves.  About Armando Minjárez Monárrez: En Cuerpo Presente](https://wam.org/whats-on/exhibitions/armando-minjarez-monarrez-en-cuerpo-presente/) 

[Featured Event\\ \\ **WAM Nights: “Pretty in Pink” Movie Night**\\ \\ November 6, 2026 | 6:00pm - 8:00pm\\ \\ In this program series, each screening features the same 1970s and 80s teenage Americana pictured in 'David Hornback: Where the Hell is Wichita?'.  About WAM Nights: “Pretty in Pink” Movie Night](https://wam.org/event/wam-nights-pretty-in-pink-movie-night/) 

[Visit\\ \\ **Group Tours**\\ \\ Explore the Wichita Art Museum with a guided or self-guided tour. Discover our collection or special exhibition. Book a tour with a WAM guide online for an immersive experience.\\ \\ Book a guided or self-guided tour for an immersive tour of our collection or special exhibition. Book online  About Group Tours](https://wam.org/visit/things-to-do/tours/) 

[What’s On\\ \\ **WAM Nights**\\ \\ WAM is open until 9 pm!\\ \\ WAM Nights feature programs with artists, musicians, and performers—don’t miss your chance to experience the art at WAM in a new way!  About WAM Nights](https://wam.org/whats-on/wam-nights/) 

[Support\\ \\ **Annual Fund**\\ \\ Give today and help art reach everyone. \\ \\ Donations are 100% tax-deductible. Every gift, big or small, makes an impact.  About Annual Fund](https://wam.org/support/support-2/annual-fund/) 

[**Membership**\\ \\ Access special exhibitions, exclusive events, discounted rates and many more perks!\\ \\ Now is the time to join WAM or renew your membership dues!   About Membership](https://wam.org/membership/) 

[Visit\\ \\ **Museum Store**\\ \\  Shop the Museum Store for fabulous finds!   \\ \\ Unique gifts for any occasion! Purchases support educational programs and events.  About Museum Store](https://wam.org/visit/things-to-do/store/) 

[Featured Exhibition\\ \\ **Revolutions: In Pursuit of a More Perfect Union**\\ \\ April 4, 2026 - March 25, 2028\\ \\ In celebration of America’s 250th anniversary, _Revolutions_ features works from the Wichita Art Museum’s collection reflecting revolutions in American history—from the Revolutionary War, women’s suffrage, civil rights, and labor movements, along with artworks created for the nation’s 1976 bicentennial.\\ \\ April 4, 2026 - March 25, 2028  About Revolutions: In Pursuit of a More Perfect Union](https://wam.org/whats-on/exhibitions/revolutions-in-pursuit-of-a-more-perfect-union/)

openGraph.description: Welcome to the Wichita Art Museum, a dynamic cultural hub located in the Museums on the River District near Downtown Wichita. Our mission is to connect people, ideas, and American art through remarkable experiences. With a permanent collection showcasing over 10,000 artworks, spanning historical to contemporary pieces, celebrating the essence of American artistic heritage.Explore diverse exhibitions, engage in thought-provoking programs designed for adults, and enjoy family-friendly activities. Connect with Wichita’s cultural scene through unique art experiences. Whether you prefer contemporary or classic art, WAM provides a vibrant space for all ages to foster a deeper connection with the arts.

## Gallery Updates

### Exciting Changes Are Underway

If you’ve visited recently, you’ve probably noticed continued activity across the museum as we work to make TMA more welcoming, accessible, and inspiring.

Much of the Green Building will be temporarily unavailable as we move into the next phase of TMA’s reinstallation project. That said, **TMA is still open—and still full of ways to explore, create, and connect with art.** 

During this time, the **Glass Pavilion** (including [special exhibitions](https://toledomuseum.org/exhibitions) and [daily glassblowing demonstrations](https://toledomuseum.org/learn/glass-blowing-demonstrations)), [**Bowe** **Family Center**](https://toledomuseum.org/learn/family-center), **Education Wing**, **Georgia and David K. Welles Sculpture Garden**, and [**Library**](https://toledomuseum.org/learn/library-archives) remain open. Restrooms, elevators, and visitor entrances also remain open, with signage in place to help guide you during your visit.

We encourage visitors to enjoy the Glass Pavilion and its programs, explore the Sculpture Garden, and participate in classes and programs while renovation continues.

We can’t wait for you to experience these enhancements when they’re complete. Every project is designed to make your visit more accessible, welcoming, and inspiring.
